title: "History of GIScRG"
description: "The origins of the GIScience Research Group and the people who have served on its committee."

We are grateful to everyone who has served on the GIScience Research Group committee at the Royal Geographical Society (with IBG). Our chairs, officers and committee members have brought researchers and practitioners together to share their work and have supported students and early-career researchers.

[Browse past committees](past-committees.qmd) · [Meet the current committee](people.qmd)

## Origins in 2002

Peter Fisher of the University of Leicester was the inaugural chair. His colleagues recalled that the idea for the group took shape at a meeting of the Association of American Geographers in 2002. The April nominations and the draft minutes of the 4 November meeting document the group's first committee. [Inaugural committee](past-committees.qmd#inaugural-committee) · [In memoriam: Prof Peter Fisher](https://www.tandfonline.com/doi/full/10.1080/13658816.2014.939655)

The group's first AGM took place in London on 5 September 2003 during the Society's annual conference. Ordnance Survey supported awards for presentations in a session on postgraduate GIS research. [September 2003 AGM record](past-committees.qmd#agm-2003)

## Milestones

**2005–06.** The group approved reciprocal committee representation with the Quantitative Methods Research Group in 2005. The following AGM reported on the first year of the arrangement. [August 2005 AGM record](past-committees.qmd#agm-2005)

**2009–11.** The 2009 AGM recorded a new dissertation competition. In 2011, the group agreed to focus the postgraduate prize on master's dissertations. [Dissertation prize archive](dissertation-prizes.qmd)

<!-- GIScRG AGM Minutes 2009.doc, treasurer's report. GIScRG AGM Minutes 2011.doc, item 4.4. -->

**2015.** The group agreed to fund two bursary places for early-career researchers at a workshop in Leicester celebrating Peter Fisher's life. [April 2015 AGM record](past-committees.qmd#agm-2015)

**2020–21.** Andrea Ballatore started the GIScience Webinar Series with Justin van Dijk and Stef De Sabbata. The series brought speakers from around the world to share their work with the group. [GIScience Webinar Series](giscience-webinar-series.qmd)

**2023.** In January, the webinar series began a collaboration with GIS Research UK (GISRUK). [Jointly organised webinars](giscience-webinar-series.qmd#past-webinars)
